_about: Wild drop tables fragment (List 17 #166) — row shape only; ZERO rows instanced, all weights OPEN data. One row, two reads: encounter generation rolls it to fill the wild individual's held slot; battle end reads it for the transfer. Hard rule: every itemId must resolve in #31's registry — nothing drops that the item layer doesn't hold. The economy faucet sentence is PROPOSED into #20's home at landing; this package does not edit #20.

channels.defeat: encounter ends by defeat -> row rolls at battle end -> item to the Ranger's bag
channels.kept: individual kept (#38) -> the carried item stays in its held slot; nothing moves to the bag, nothing duplicates
channels.otherEndings: Ranger flees / wild flees or vanishes (#152) -> nothing transfers, either channel
channels.singleObject: one carried item transfers once, never through both channels

open_register: every drop row: species, item, weight, channels
per-species ruling on whether the defeat channel exists at all
drop fiction review standard (rows should make sense against the species' sheet/ecology) — content standard, not schema
rollDiscipline: fresh roll per encounter; no pity counter, no stored luck — the save records bag contents, never rolls

rowShape.weight: relative within the species' drop set, normalised at roll (#7 weight idiom)

validation: kept-channel items pass #31 useContext.held (the held slot is what #109's validator reads)
no key-category item may appear in a drop row — key items are authored placements
